name: socratic-companion
description: Watches your code for common bug patterns and nudges you with Socratic questions instead of answers.

socraticCompanion.backendUrl.description: Base URL of the /diagnose backend (the socratic-backend server, backed by qwen2.5-coder:7b via Ollama). Set to empty to always use the local fallback regex patterns instead.

socraticCompanion.authToken.description: Bearer token attached to backend requests. Temporary setting until the OAuth handshake into context.secrets lands.

socraticCompanion.failedTestThreshold.description: Number of consecutive failed test runs that force a nudge check regardless of chunk completion.
